ingredients.name: Smoked Salmon
ingredients.originalText: 1/3 lb Smoked Salmon, cut into wide strips

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 12 oz Linguine; 1/2 lb Asparagus, cut into 2" pieces; 1/4 lb Green Beans, halved; 1 cup Sugar Snap Peas, trimmed; 1/2 cup Frozen Edamame or Peas; 1 Tbsp Butter; 1 small Onion, minced; 2 cloves Garlic, minced; 3 Tbsp All-Purpose Flour; 2 1/2 cup Milk; 1/3 lb Smoked Salmon, cut into wide strips; 1/2 cup Fresh Mint, coarsely chopped; 1/2 Lemon. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Asparagus: cut into 2" pieces; Onion: small; minced; Garlic: minced; Smoked Salmon: cut into wide strips; Mint: Fresh; coarsely chopped. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook linguine 10 min or until al dente, adding asparagus, beans, and sugar snap peas during the last 3 minutes of cooking and edamame during the last minute.
Meanwhile in large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring 3 minutes.
Very gradually whisk in milk until smooth and stir often until mixture boils and has thickened (5 mins).
Add pasta mixture, stirring until hot.
Stir in salmon and mint just until mixed.
Squeeze juice from lemon into pasta and stir.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook linguine 10 min or until al dente, adding asparagus, beans, and sugar snap peas during the last 3 minutes of cooking and edamame during the last minute. Drain very well.
2. Meanwhile in large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring 3 minutes. Stir in flour. Very gradually whisk in milk until smooth and stir often until mixture boils and has thickened (5 mins).
3. Add pasta mixture, stirring until hot. Stir in salmon and mint just until mixed. Squeeze juice from lemon into pasta and stir.
